requirement: v3.0.0: the Fang decision center is ported to W2M as @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/decision-center (host module, /api/w2m/decisions* routes, GPW page and GPW launcher panel) and its ported test suites pass

assertions.port: src/decision-center/index.mjs is the Fang plugin module with import specifiers and plugin name rewritten only; its four lib dependencies and the MIT schemastery are copied verbatim, and kernel.mjs supplies the Fang kernel names on W2M paths
assertions.service: apply() provides w2mDecisionCenter with 27 methods and registers request_human_decision / ask_user_choice
assertions.routes: 14 /api/w2m/decisions* routes registered on the connection fetch registry, including the SSE events and AI advise streams; create -> list -> item -> quota -> resolve round-trips through HTTP
assertions.panel: DecisionCenterSection renders inside GpwPanel, which GpwSettingsPage embeds and GpwLauncher opens, so the GPW page and the GPW launcher show the same center; it polls every 4s, groups by level, resolves via the ticket options, abandons option-less tickets and only displays AI advice
assertions.suites: 92 tests pass: 79 ported Fang decision-center tests + 10 outbox/events/ingest tests + 3 new route-surface tests
assertions.not_ported: decision-center-fork and decision-action-integration stay out: the former needs the Fang mother/fork role matrix, the latter the Fang orchestrator and restart-guard, neither of which exists in W2M
assertions.artifact: scripts/pack.mjs packs dist/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-3.0.0.tgz deterministically; the published sha256 is the one release.yml writes into dist/SHA256SUMS, so the record does not restate the hash of the archive that contains it
